title: Create Feature Branch for Documentation Update
description: Create a new feature branch specifically for updating the repository summary heading to maintain clean version control practices.
details: Create a new branch from the main branch using the naming convention 'docs/update-summary-heading'. This follows best practices for documentation changes and allows for proper code review through pull requests. Use git commands: 'git checkout main', 'git pull origin main', 'git checkout -b docs/update-summary-heading'.
test_strategy: Verify the branch was created successfully by checking 'git branch' output and confirming the current branch is the newly created feature branch.

title: Update Repository Summary Heading
description: Locate and modify the main heading in the project's primary documentation file to improve clarity and impact by leading with the project name.
details: Find the primary markdown documentation file (likely README.md) in the repository root. Locate the line containing '## Enhanced Repository Summary: AI Schedule Auditor' and change it to '## AI Schedule Auditor: Enhanced Repository Summary'. This reordering puts the project name first, which aligns with the project's visual identity and improves readability. Ensure no other formatting or content is modified.
test_strategy: Preview the markdown file in a markdown editor or viewer to ensure the heading renders correctly and maintains proper formatting. Verify that only the intended line was modified by reviewing the git diff.

title: Commit and Create Pull Request
description: Commit the documentation change using conventional commit standards and create a pull request for review and merge.
details: Stage the modified documentation file using 'git add'. Create a commit with a conventional commit message following the format 'docs: improve repository summary heading' to clearly indicate this is a documentation change. Push the branch to the remote repository and create a pull request with a descriptive title and summary of the change. After review and approval, merge the pull request and delete the feature branch.
test_strategy: Verify the commit message follows conventional commit standards. After merging, check that the updated heading is visible on the main branch of the repository and renders correctly on the code hosting platform (e.g., GitHub).
